model.title: 'Silence is more valuable than ever.' Discuss.

parts.text: Thesis: silence is scarce, so it is precious
Angle 1: noise of screens and notifications
Angle 2: silence for thought, prayer and rest
Counter: silence can hide problems that need speaking
Ending: choose silence deliberately, not by accident

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: We have never had more ways to speak, or fewer moments to listen. Our phones hum in our pockets, our rooms murmur with screens, and even our walks come with a soundtrack of notifications. Silence, once ordinary, has become rare, and rare things are precious.
